name: design-ops
description: DesignOps — one design in Figma, shipped to every framework and verified by @designops/lint. Token pipeline, multi-framework components, request workflow, living docs and an agent-first linter. By Lulamile Mkhungela.
author: Lulamile Mkhungela <mkhungela.l@gmail.com>

scripts.test:lint: pnpm --filter @designops/lint run build && pnpm --filter @designops/lint run test
scripts.corpus: pnpm --filter @designops/lint run build && pnpm --filter evals run corpus
scripts.corpus:check: pnpm --filter @designops/lint run build && pnpm --filter evals run corpus:check
scripts.evals: pnpm --filter @designops/lint run build && pnpm --filter evals run run
scripts.release: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run corpus:check && changeset publish
